title: Research: rank 34d for PR3335's block-valued plane mask
body:
PR3335 gives a new P112 matching with exact scalar fitting rank 34. This adds a source-bound independent check and the explicit block-payload consequence: **minimum rank 34d over every field and every d >= 1**, allowing directed, nonsymmetric and noncommuting free d-by-d blocks. Its predecessor clique forces I_(34d); its predecessor support construction attains the bound. The matching, scalar construction and clique retain PR3335's credit.

The audit also separates the 28-support lower bound for disjoint-support constructions from a lower bound for arbitrary fitting matrices across all matchings. An explicit classical 27-line rational fixture has fitting rank 7 while every disjoint support has size at most 3 (so any support partition needs at least 9). This checks the logical distinction; it is **not** a P112 counterexample below 28.

Eight files are confined to `research/rematch-block-rank-audit/`. Sources are canonical main `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c` and the byte-identical certificate at PR3335 head `1d46df8b5aeac49d165cae58c1dd1036666bb789`. The verifier imports no predecessor executable and uses only the standard library. The separate concurrent full-plane tariff audit is PR3345, head `529959bb00abd01664b7109d2e40574ecb0c8da1`; its result was read and credited, not repriced here. Coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-19007618.

Validation on CPython 3.12.14, macOS arm64:

- `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rematch-block-rank-audit` passes metadata/pins and both registered commands.
- Independent full-plane/basis masks agree on all 11,440 forced port entries; support and clique identity minors pass. Charted ranks are 34d for d=1,2,3 over GF(2), GF(3), GF(101); actual noncommuting free blocks and all 224 source-coordinate plus 224 dirty-target columns pass.
- Eight semantic/input rejection controls, the exact rational 27-line control, and five real-CLI integrity rejections pass, including optimized Python, source corruption and boolean/float receipt corruption.
- Publication-byte preflight and the final committed export pass. Normal/optimized mathematical replay and the integrity suite pass from the Git-free export with an empty executable PATH, with every exported byte unchanged.

The README contains the all-field/all-size dimension proof; finite ranks are corroboration, not extrapolation. No native recipe or copy price, chronological acquisition, physical restoration/storage/hosting, precision/tape, bit supplier, complete paid invoice, all-size supplier or outer transfer is established. No selected cold replay or formal-kernel build ran. No supplier, kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed; hosted CI and human review are separate. Open next questions name the actual global-rank and changed-factor/consumer obligations.

Credit Matarener/Mark and Claude (PR3335); Sagar Thakrar/thakrarsagar (PR2484); ywz65 (PR2471 and the older rank-49d block interface); Cinna Davis/1337isnot1337 (PR1825/2126/2118); Adam Gall (PR1889); ctoth, Philippe Van Velzen and Jeremy Diviney for the plane/tariff/payload distinction; and the retained Rohan Arun/Jeremy Kothe/icekylinx source lineage. The classical control and block framework retain Haemers/Blasiak/Bukh/Cox attribution. Prepared for Arham Tahir with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. No independent human review is claimed.
